# Summary

In assessing compliance with our [Data and Code Availability Policy](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/journals/jpe/datapolicy), our reproducibility team has identified the following issues, which we ask you to address:

1.  We will schedule a remote replication session.
2.  There are a few small things to fix. Please resubmit and we take it from there.

They should also provide reasonable assistance to requests for clarification and replication."

# Replication

- Downloaded code and data from dropbox.
- Copied git repo and unzipped the replication package into this repo.
- Adjusted the root of the `00_Master.do` as per `README.md`
- Ran code as per README. Code broke because of missing packages `center`. Ran again.
- Ran code as per README. Code broke because of missing packages `require`. Ran again.
- Ran code as per README. Code broke because of missing packages `ivreg_ss`. Ran again.
- Code ran as expected. Differences in output. See @sec-findings
- Upon agreement with the author, run the do-files for the part with confidential data contained in `build_documentation/scripts`. 
- After adjusting the root path in the do-file `MS20241468_Deposit/build_documentation/scripts/00_master_build.do` and `MS20241468_Deposit/build_documentation/scripts/09_master_build.do`, code broke with the error:

```
47. file U:/Downloads/Carlo Medici - MS20241468_JPE_Replication_20260708/MS20241468_Deposit/data/_raw_local/IPUMS/IPUMS_fullcount_1880.dta not found
r(601);
```

- Adjusted the root path in the do-file `MS20241468_Deposit/build_documentation/scripts/build/b9_names.do` and code run without errors.

- We interrupted the session after 60 minutes and continued the day after. In the continuing session, we checked the PID of the Stata window and uploaded the folders `MS20241468_Deposit/data/intermediate` and `MS20241468_Deposit/data/public` as specified by the `MS20241468_Deposit/build_documentation/README.md` to be the only one affected by those scripts.

- After running the `b**` scripts, checked all the files generated using `KDiff3`. All dataset matched. No difference was detected.

## Reason for incomplete reproducibility

- [ ] None.
- [x] `Discrepancy in output` (either figures or numbers in tables or text differ)
- [ ] `Bugs in code` that were fixable by the replicator (but should be fixed in the final deposit)
- [ ] `Code missing`, in particular if it prevented the replicator from completing the reproducibility check
  - [ ] `Data preparation code missing` should be checked if the code missing seems to be data preparation code
- [ ] `Code not functional` is more severe than a simple bug: it prevented the replicator from completing the reproducibility check
- [ ] `Software not available to replicator` may happen for a variety of reasons, but in particular (a) when the software is commercial, and the replicator does not have access to a licensed copy, or (b) the software is open-source, but a specific version required to conduct the reproducibility check is not available.
- [ ] `Insufficient time available to replicator` is applicable when (a) running the code would take weeks or more (b) running the code might take less time if sufficient compute resources were to be brought to bear, but no such resources can be accessed in a timely fashion (c) the replication package is very complex, and following all (manual and scripted) steps would take too long.
- [ ] `Data missing` is marked when data *should* be available, but was erroneously not provided, or is not accessible via the procedures described in the replication package
- [ ] `Data not available` is marked when data requires additional access steps, for instance purchase or application procedure.
- [ ] `Missing README` is marked if there is no README to guide the replicator, or the README is not in compliance with JPE requirements
